reason: This plugin is a file-upload utility for DeepSeek Harness web chat that adds a composer attachment UI, uploads files to host storage, manages attachments in an on-page dock, and injects attachments into user messages with model-aware formatting, while using SHA-256-based deduplication to avoid redundant storage.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 网页对话输入区新增附件按钮，支持上传文件到主机并以附件卡片管理，再按当前模型类型将图片或文件路径注入到用户消息中。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a file attachment button to the DeepSeek Harness web composer, lets users upload files to host storage, and injects attachment references into user messages with model-aware handling.

capabilities: Upload user-selected files from the web composer to DSH host storage
Display uploaded attachments as persistent cards with preview and remove controls
Inject attachment references into outgoing user messages
Detect model modality to choose image-block injection versus path-text injection
Compute SHA-256 hashes and reuse stored files via a persisted index for deduplication

reasons.code: Repository README describes a paperclip attach button that uploads files to the DSH host and shows preview-style attachment cards.
README specifies model-aware behavior where multimodal models receive native ImageBlock injection and text-only models receive file path text blocks.
README documents SHA-256 based content-addressed deduplication persisted in uploads/.dfu-index.json, with reused paths for identical content.
Package manifest declares a DSH web plugin/client bundle entry, confirming integration with the DeepSeek Harness web platform.
